cache_policy: No document cache between logical reads; OS cache uncontrolled and not measured as disk IO
preflight_owner: coordinator only; no preflight implementation in this package
python_dependencies: standard library only; no pip installation
primary_completion: successes / auditable execution-started slots; slot starts before arm preparation; failed/capped/timed-out slots are non-completions, lost lifecycle is null
primary_bytes: actual UTF-8 newly study-supplied system/user/driver content once; all started slots; unknown delivery null
success_integrity: supported delivery plus accurate finish and no earlier unsupported commit; blocked requests may recover
full_suite_missingness: unstarted or unknown required cell prevents full-suite interaction; observed subset labelled separately
audit_axes: known_started, completion_known/unknown, workload_known/unknown reported separately; byte corruption never removes an independently valid completion
event_completeness: require instrument closure action count and terminal event hash; missing/truncated events make completion null while verified unsafe prefix remains observed
message_completeness: require explicit writer-side count/hash closure bound to final receipt; missing/truncated ledger null, no empty-file zero inference
